subject: Code review sampling & CD pipeline attestation for SOC2/SIG
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia@veridian-assessors.com>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, AvaBank SOC2 Team <audit@avabank.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sample artifacts for code review / CD attestation

Markus —

Thanks for the quick intake yesterday. As part of AvaBank's SOC2/SIG assessment we're asking Redwood to provide a compact artifact package that demonstrates your secure SDLC controls across code review, CI/CD gating, secrets handling, and change approval. To be concise, please provide the following by EOD Friday, 2025-08-01: 

- A 30-PR sample (merged during the past 6 months) with metadata showing approvers, timestamps, and any automated checks.
- CI run logs for a representative pipeline execution tied to at least 5 of the sampled PRs (redact secrets).
- Branch protection / PR gating policy screenshots or config (branch rules, required status checks, required reviewers).
- Evidence of ephemeral secret usage (short-lived token creation & rotation) and a short note on how the pipeline avoids long-lived secrets.
- Change approval records for any emergency releases in that 6-month window (who approved, why, rollback plan).
- Keystore rotation schedule and the last rotation entry (date + actor).

If you plan to send as Drive links or a zipped bundle, please indicate the chosen transfer method and any redaction approach you will use. We may request clarification after review.

Thanks — appreciate a point-of-contact we can follow up with.

Lydia Chen
Senior Assessor, Veridian Assessors
lydia@veridian-assessors.com
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia@veridian-assessors.com>, AvaBank SOC2 Team <audit@avabank.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample artifacts for code review / CD attestation

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the requested package by EOD Friday. High-level plan: 

- Deliver a ZIP containing a 30-PR CSV manifest plus pull request exports, a sample of CI run logs (redacted), and keystore rotation CSV. Attached: ci-pipeline-runbook-v2.pdf (runbook & gating controls).
- We'll provide the actual logs and artifacts via a restricted Drive folder (link below) and also send a DocuSign envelope for the confidentiality attestation if you prefer.
- Redaction approach: we will replace any token values with <REDACTED> and include a short mapping file indicating where secrets were removed.
- Point of contact: jordan.blake@redwood.ai for CI logs and irene.choi@redwood.ai for the keystore/change governance notes.

Attachments included in this email: ci-pipeline-runbook-v2.pdf (runbook), keystore-rotation-summary.csv (summary export). We'll push the code-review-sample.zip to Drive and share the link once internal approvals are complete.

If you have a format preference for the PR metadata (CSV vs JSON), let us know — we'll default to CSV.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 31 Jul 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sample artifacts for code review / CD attestation

Folks — quick internal coordination: per Markus' plan I'll own the PR selection/redaction checklist, Jordan will pull CI runs and redact logs, Kimberly will extract branch protection configs and the emergency change approvals.

Action items: 
- Jordan: deliver 5 representative CI runs and the runbook export by tomorrow EOD.
- Kimberly: export branch protection rules from GitHub org + screenshot of required checks.
- Markus: I'll assemble the 30-PR manifest and mark which PRs were backfilled or squashed.

We'll upload to the shared Drive folder and ping Lydia when complete. Include a short readme in the ZIP describing the redaction strategy.

Irene
Irene Choi
Principal Engineer, DevEx (sec)
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Delivery: code review sample + CI/CD attestation artifacts

Lydia / AvaBank team — attaching the artifact bundle and links per Markus' plan. Summary below: 

Attachments included (attached to this email and in Drive):
- code-review-sample.zip (30-PR exports + PR-manifest.csv)
- ci-pipeline-runbook-v2.pdf (pipeline gating, required checks, rollback playbook)
- keystore-rotation-summary.csv (rotation dates, actors; last rotation 2025-06-02)

Drive link (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xy123-example
DocuSign confidentiality envelope: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123

Notes on redaction and selection: 
- We selected PRs across infra, runtime, and SDK teams. PR-manifest.csv includes reviewer usernames and auto-check statuses; token values in logs replaced with <REDACTED>.
- CI logs: we provided full step-level logs for five representative runs; secret environments (env var values) are omitted and annotated.
- Branch protection: screenshot + policy JSON in the ZIP showing required status checks and required reviewers.
- Change approvals: emergency release entries include approver email and timestamp; sensitive customer identifiers redacted.

If you want us to export these directly into your S3 intake or preferred secure portal, we can arrange a one-time transfer. Happy to jump on a short call if reviewers want walkthrough.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Security Engineer, CI/CD Controls
Redwood Inference
